items.name: COMPEED Small Hydrocolloid Blister Plasters
items.subtitle: Exact target: Small 2 × 6 cm blister plaster — or the U.S. mixed pack that includes the same Small size.
items.notes: The German package is COMPEED Blasenpflaster Small, 6 pieces, 2 × 6 cm. In the U.S., the easiest close match is usually COMPEED Advanced Blister Care Mixed Sizes; the 10-count pack includes 4 Small patches. Prefer an all-Small pack if one is available at a sensible price.

research.us: U.S. COMPEED mixed 10-count: about $10.49 (~$1.05 per patch overall; 4 are Small).
research.germany: German exact Small 6-pack: roughly €5.92–€8.89 (~$6.87–$10.31 at the exchange rate checked).
research.regularBandage: Ordinary Band-Aid Flexible Fabric: about $0.13 each, but it is not a hydrocolloid blister dressing and is not an equivalent product.
research.decision: Buy COMPEED when treating an actual friction blister; target ≤ $11 for the U.S. pack. If buying only Small patches, an all-Small pack is better value than paying for mixed sizes you will not use.
